note: PROVISIONAL. Derived from container runs of the SO-04 completion harness plus a margin. Not hardware evidence, and not a program-plan section 8 target: those are unchanged. Read only by the service-objective harness and validator; the core never reads this file and nothing here changes when or how a lease is released.

basis.method: py/azazel_edge/service_objectives/so04_rollback_completion.py on main after #439 and #441: real azazel-edge-core daemon (Edge defaults, enforcement off), owned state installed per lease (a TBF root qdisc on a dummy interface per throttle lease, an inet azazel_edge rule per isolate/redirect lease), monotonic lease deadlines (every sample expiry_clock monotonic), start and end both read on CLOCK_BOOTTIME, half the leases expiring under the harness's eve_flood load (2000 EVE alerts/s); docker --cap-add NET_ADMIN on colima, aarch64
basis.margin_rule: twice the max observed, rounded up to the next 1000 ms
basis.clock_stability: wall_clock_stable_during_run was unmet in all 3 runs (wall-minus-monotonic drift -107.0, -121.7 and -113.5 ms against a 50 ms tolerance; the colima VM's wall clock was adjusted during each run). Elapsed times are on CLOCK_BOOTTIME and every lease expired on its monotonic deadline, so the drift does not enter them, but no run is clean. Earlier run sets (before #439, and before #441 when throttle never completed) are superseded and not used.
